source.origin: ImageGen transparent character cutout from the original Rin reference

upscaler.name: nihui/waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan
upscaler.noise_explanation: -1 disables denoising. RGB is neural-upscaled; the original coverage alpha mask is separately bicubic-upscaled using ImageMagick and reattached without RGB compositing.
upscaler.working_directory: Repository yuru directory; source/output paths default relative to the script.
upscaler.alpha_workaround: Direct RGBA GPU output had incomplete alpha on this host (mean 0.133753 instead of source 0.642601). Separate RGB inference and original alpha resize avoid that defect.

alpha.method: ImageMagick alpha extract statistics; source mostly alpha 253/255 so nearly opaque interior retained; transparent and intermediate pixels preserved.

verification.visual: Full character and silhouette inspected against Yuru bg after separate RGB/alpha upscale; no background added.
